recap.text: La Ciguapa drops a Glow-Up, which freezes a card in its current buffed state for good. Donut spends it on a Combo of two problem cards, not on Shi Maria, whom they need alive, to fit Katia's Jola. It yields Lazarus-A-Bang-Bang, level 140. Ren hands Carl her cards, and Donut spends her Glow Up fusing Lazarus with Skylar Spinach for good.

beats.headline: Not on the list
beats.text: The second card La Ciguapa drops is a mythic special effect card that is not on the list of known card types: Glow-Up, consumable. Cast on any active card or totem, theirs or an enemy's, it changes the card so it permanently reflects its current state. A totem that summons for 120 seconds, buffed with a Time Extend and then given a Glow-Up, summons for 240 in future battles. One use only. Stack the buffs cleverly, and an already strong card becomes practically immortal.
beats.gist: The Glow-Up card, dropped by La Ciguapa, permanently locks in a card's or totem's current buffed state, once.

beats.headline: Spent on a fusion
beats.text: From the practice arena Donut reports that Shi Maria wanted the Glow-Up used on her. Donut spent it otherwise, on her own judgment. To fit Katia's Jola into the deck, she combined two of the problem cards with the consumable Combo card, used up all the utility buffs on them, and then cast the Glow-Up to make the change permanent. Getting rid of Shi Maria, or combining her, was considered and dropped: they need her to survive what comes next.
beats.gist: Donut spent the Glow-Up herself, fusing two problem cards with Combo so Katia's Jola fits.

beats.headline: Frozen with its buffs
beats.text: Church organ music, fat digital cherubs and a herd of digital street dogs: the new totem's reveal is the craziest of all their cards. After the fight Carl reads its orange card. Unique. Lazarus-A-Bang-Bang. Level 140. Created via Combo, and frozen in place via a Glow-Up with active buffs, its available utility slots lowered as a result. Summoning duration two hundred seconds; Constitution eighty.
beats.gist: Carl reads the orange card: Lazarus-A-Bang-Bang, level 140, made by Combo, frozen by Glow-Up.

beats.headline: Ren's last cards
beats.text: Ren has rearranged her deck and taken out everything but her totems, and she gives Carl all the rest, a few rare specials and mystics among them that she never got to use. The last two are a consumable Glow-Up card and a consumable special called The Midnight Express, two large men in tights. The cards will not go into his inventory, so he sticks them in the waistband of his boxers. Make them suffer, she says.
beats.gist: Ren gives Carl her leftover cards, and he tucks two into his boxers.

beats.headline: Lazarus and Skylar, for good
beats.text: Alpha Male Carl is in the deck only because they were a totem short: Donut used the Golden Combo to fuse Lazarus with Skylar Spinach, and then added Ren's other consumable card, the Glow Up, to make the combination permanent. The stronger versions of Asojano and Uzi Jesus make it a great, powerful combo, the more so since a single card may come with them onto the next floor.
beats.gist: Donut fuses Lazarus with Skylar Spinach using the Golden Combo, then makes the Glow Up permanent.
